question: What faculties and institutes comprise SRGI Lucknow?
expected_fact: SRGI includes Faculty of Engineering & Technology, Faculty of Management, Faculty of Pharmacy, etc. under S. R. Group of Institutions.
answer: SRGI Lucknow comprises four core academic faculties: 1. Faculty of Engineering & Technology: Offers Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) and Master of Technology (M.Tech) degrees. 2. Faculty of Management Studies: Offers Master of Business Administration (MBA), Integrated MBA (IMBA), and Applied Global Management Programmes (AGMP). Additionally, SRGI Lucknow has two constituent academic units: 1. S. R. Institute of Management & Technology (SRIMT): Focuses on Engineering (B.Tech, M.Tech) and Management (MBA, IMBA), IMBA, and AGMP. 2. SRM Business School (SRMBS): Offers various management programmes.

question: What is the admission procedure and eligibility for B.Tech at SRGI Lucknow?
expected_fact: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics along with Chemistry/CS/Bio, admission through AKTU counselling / JEE Main / CUET / direct admission.
answer: The admission procedure for B.Tech at SRGI Lucknow involves two primary channels: 1. **State Level Counselling (UPTAC / JEE Main score)**: This is based on scores from the Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC) or JEE Main scores for B.Tech. 2. **Direct Institutional Merit Admission**: Eligible candidates can apply directly to SRGI Lucknow through the online portal or at the campus admission cell under the management / vacant seats quota as per regulatory norms. Eligibility for B.Tech at SRGI Lucknow includes: - A minimum aggregate of 45% marks (40% for SC/ST candidates). - A 10+2 qualification from CBSE, ICSE, UP Board, or any recognized equivalent board. - Mandatory subjects of Physics and Mathematics, along with one optional subject (Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or Technical Vocational subject).

question: Tell me about CSE intake and affiliations at SRGI.
expected_fact: B.Tech CSE sanctioned intake of 180 seats, affiliated with AKTU Lucknow and approved by AICTE.
answer: At S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI), Lucknow, the B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) programme has a sanctioned annual intake of 180 seats. The programme is affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi. SRGI offers this programme alongside specialized tracks in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI & ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Data Science (AI & DS), each with a dedicated intake of 60 seats.
